vina_ad.score_coordinates.reason: explicit vina, vinardo and ad4 source-level pair replay with full term recombination
vina_ad.score_coordinates.primal: family-selected coordinate pair energy with fixed topology; maps can be supplied through recombine_terms
vina_ad.score_coordinates.math_convention: real-linear; family cutoffs, caps, source potential knots and coincident points are non-differentiable
vina_ad.score_coordinates.dependency_chain: score_coordinates -> family potentials -> weighted recombination -> torsion correction
vina_ad.score_coordinates.oracle: tests/test_score.py and tests/test_full_surface.py source transcriptions, finite differences and term consistency
vina_ad.score_coordinates.decision: implemented coordinate/pair and precomputed-term surface; maps/search remain outside scope

vina_ad.score.reason: alias of the family-selected score_coordinates replay

vina_ad.energy.reason: alias of the family-selected score_coordinates replay

vina_ad.score_family.reason: explicitly named alias for the sf_name-aware score surface

vina_ad.potential_terms.primal: six Vina or five Vinardo/AD4 source potential sums over fixed pairs

vina_ad.score_terms.primal: one contribution per family weight; vector sum equals composed score

vina_ad.recombine_terms.reason: complete weighted accumulation over precomputed interactions
vina_ad.recombine_terms.primal: source ScoringFunction recombination for six Vina or five Vinardo/AD4 potential sums
vina_ad.recombine_terms.dependency_chain: recombine_terms -> weighted potential sum -> conf-independent torsion

vina_ad.term_values.reason: raw feature vector for calibration and regression
vina_ad.term_values.primal: potential sums plus fixed torsion count

vina_ad.ScoringFunction.reason: mirrors upstream family selection and set_weights state API
vina_ad.ScoringFunction.primal: pure Python facade over score_coordinates and score_terms
vina_ad.ScoringFunction.derivative_interface: use pure callables for ChainRules rules
